policy_name: Abu Dhabi Population Health Intelligence Policy
governing_body: Abu Dhabi Public Health Centre (ADPHC) & Department of Health Abu Dhabi (DoH)

equity_framework.benchmark_methodology: ADPHC Population Reference Baseline: Abu Dhabi Central metropolitan region serves as the primary benchmark because it encompasses the tertiary health centres, 68% of the established screening infrastructure, and the historical baseline coverage target under the Abu Dhabi Healthcare Strategic Plan.
